# WO-116: Printable summary layout checks (CP-07)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (Nora dispatches)
Source: docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md CP-07 (accepted in CLAUDE-016)

## Goal
Per CP-07: render the app's printable summary with fake empty, single-site and many-site data using existing test/browser fixtures; check narrow screen and print media, long fake labels/site names, page breaks, readable counts, and that requested / confirmed-removed / not-found stay distinct. Record browser, paper size and what was verified or not. Browser print preview is not PDF support; do not claim it.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests pass offline; ruff clean; obviously fake data only.
- docs/vendor/summary-print-qa.md lists checks, results and any defects with the owning file. Defects are reported, not fixed (a product fix is a separate WO).

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/test_wizard_summary_print_layout.py (new)
- docs/vendor/summary-print-qa.md (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
src/ (all product code), tests/test_wizard_summary_regressions.py and other existing tests, consent, mail, storage.

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done. Worktree: .vendor-wt/wo-116, cut from main by the owner.
